notes.title: Final University Update
notes.content:
[u][h1]Hello Runners![/h1]
[/u]
[h3][b] This is our last update as a full university team, but a portion of the team plans to continue working on Hermes' Runner after graduation.[/b] 

[i]Stay tuned...
[/i]
For now, our major focus was on polishing the game and fixing bugs, especially based on community feedback. Check it![/h3]

[img]https://media-hosting.imagekit.io/85047183208548c7/Hermes_NewStuff.png?Expires=1839705886&Key-Pair-Id=K2ZIVPTIP2VGHC&Signature=QvByrrJ-A3xvHVnTGnwTRm~GoYdfJ~NIjX1JdBvlHwWlfwoPT7eZ0ozXsthEbKRvf-KVY52h8RmFvqjr9~TQ-hShCG7iFS7O3yzCjnt5HOqSt4b32tNhG8vOtEpanlMx-RUWbZ8cU6Eoem06FUhx3DwXSecXHyhaVK24RAuLl9A1i-hKbWbppcQ~eNLgBADROPD8wwgrrgjF64fXKdjgrMI6q3kXosmGv8GwzY4fK8qZbcjf2tVhNbTFxAvOtW11hGxV1LCMIGbmN498L2JY0pulCcbBgJr0BnSD3uELByAyE7s0~gYHDufHYxFaCtcg46ptBBs8x-z7aN92XWJjqQ__[/img]
[list]
[*] Playable on Mac!
[*] Bounce on the umbrella-ella-ellas.
[*] Fresh stylin’ animations for Alex, the Hermes Runner.
[*] More billboards hidden around the city. Can you find them all??
[*] Message delivery leaderboard feature!!
[*] Compare your fastest times against other players globally and on your Steam friends list!
[*] Settings menu with adjustable graphics. (Some say the game is now even playable on a toaster.) ((They are lying…))
[/list]
[img]https://media-hosting.imagekit.io/cd3b2c4a79f14dcf/Hermes_Polish.png?Expires=1839705886&Key-Pair-Id=K2ZIVPTIP2VGHC&Signature=qW6cmiq-wBRPRRiR4ip~ISv1sns-~iQgQwYQtX6EsewV78XtPw4UMtXdH5P--B9WJNbu074dgqjqr0rEfv3TPJxfU1uIPhUe5kLq1xSMPUwu6e1FivvN5BTlOHw0k4dYuVeeIbTq5ll7rggUeUWfN7PAZXiUTzDOjnNfOSnPerMTkTWa2Y35yVjnShxqvGoTt8cCZytmpXBiefA4coC1Te1UfPgk1cowYaZrSH6pBOxlgPdzxLga7UmgaJo3ef1~aHIsAj9jjgwrd3bS7bQqz-pjOorO3087K1OkxE8DiSRc3Nlir8hxB3ISqZ92kgez-nlotmzjxav8mewjKtImiQ__[/img]
[list]
[*] Added loading screen before main menu.
[*] Prettied up the dialogue boxes.
[*] Delivery results screen updated for clarity.
[*] Pressing “R” to restart now restarts the current delivery instead of the entire game.
[*] More sound effects - “heh, nice!”
[*] Volume equalized for voice lines.
[*] Message pickup hitbox increased.
[*] Corrected collision of multiple objects - trees are less evil!!
[*] Tweaked the movement system to focus more on momentum.
[*] Movement adjusted for more player control at lower speeds. (Don’t worry you can still go hyper-light speed.)
[*] Revised controls to be more flexible within a single system for controller players:
[*] Bumper Jumper — LB to jump & RB to dash
[*] Traditional — A to jump & B to dash
[*] (Planning to have customizable controls in a future update.)
[/list]
[img]https://media-hosting.imagekit.io/33e2380a957148e2/Hermes_BugFixes.png?Expires=1839705886&Key-Pair-Id=K2ZIVPTIP2VGHC&Signature=BSkXK6nmo8WwroI4beRZFWhVqA9BHGuJRh8ZC4ebNsjrl9TPcaPkO7gZehW9XdqzYs43FB-xJOFYYO33HBX-VFKYv20JHjdKtBsX-d97cO71aRjPwEUBrjcwHWY50SLVsI35gjJ6VHe728HY0LQ3YgtSpXrdCl4yjE7HqQ3eSDXFum8HcIBMWiL64HXz7vbPebmKvxbKWEb2eURX9Q85scpHof8QDgtyZqdI0acwJL566-UdO1X1FQfZqS3RgYHThRYds86i0umDSnp2BRqx1Lnyl0qHydCRLpnWlTOBb1popCJhPQujGICapTZ9UTZMHNU6mAc9dSNm1wujb6dsAA__[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed jump failing under certain conditions.
[*] Mantle maintains momentum.
[*] Mantle no longer removes double jump.
[*] Temple worker audio fixed (now stereo).
[*] Music no longer cuts out randomly.
[*] Game in focus on start up.
[*] Resetting at the end-level screen now always works.
[*] Credits scroll.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]
